trailhead.name: Upper Works / Bradley Pond (Santanoni) trailhead, Santanoni Road off Upper Works Road, Newcomb

identifiedBy.fact: Wikipedia route section: the Bradley Pond Trail starts at a parking lot in the Upper Works area; Panther herd path leaves it about 4.3 mi in; pureadirondacks and adirondackhub agree (trailhead ~50 ft up Santanoni Road, 2.0 mi up Upper Works Rd)

placements.name: Upper Works parking area, Santanoni Range

otherFacts.value: 4.3 mi on Bradley Pond Trail to unmarked Panther junction, 0.2 mi south of Santanoni lean-to
0.3 mi west to Panther Brook, 0.5 mi along brook, 0.5 mi climb to junction, 0.5 mi right to summit

notes: Route text says Upper Works; three pages (Wikipedia, adirondackhub, pureadirondacks) agree there is ONE start for Bradley Pond / Santanoni range trails: the lot at Upper Works area, trailhead just off Santanoni Rd. No NYSDEC coordinate found; only coordinate is adirondackhub's (weak, not an official source). Trailforks lists 44.14191,-74.1069 for Bradley Pond but that is not near Upper Works (inconsistent, ignored). Alternative approach from Duck Hole is a loop mention only, not a start. Upper Works vs 'Santanoni Road' wording is the same lot.

Two searches ('Sasquatch's Breath' Big Snow Mountain, and trip report search) returned no page naming this route. Opened none about it (search results only listed Mountaineers/WTA/SummitPost pages for other Big Snow routes: NE ridge via Hardscrabble Lakes, NW shoulder, winter scramble). Candidate starts on the peak: Dingford Creek (USFS 47.517325,-121.4543; sibling East Buttress) and Hardscrabble Lakes / Middle Fork road, plus Myrtle Lake NW side; face of this route unknown. Stuck.

identifiedBy.fact: Chianti Spire trip report: HWY 20 parking at about 4,250 ft, trail east to Burgundy Col (~3 h); route's own road text names the same pullout near MP 166; approach to Chianti same as Silver Star

placements.name: Silver Star Mountain trailhead (first pullout after Cutthroat Creek TH, Hwy 20)
Burgundy Col (USFS point, sits at the pullout)

otherFacts.value: J. Hieb and A. Maki 1952, 5.6 (Beckey II 5.6) per search summary only

notes: Only ONE start is in use for the Wine Spires side: the Hwy 20 pullout and Burgundy Col trail (stephabegg Chianti page; WTA Silver Star page; ncmountainguides Paisano page also returns to the highway via Burgundy Col). stephabegg mentions an unspecified 'Silver Creek' alternative with no detail; not a competing standard. Evidence is indirect (no page specific to the 1952 north face), so medium confidence; WTA milepost (165) vs road text (166) differ by about one mile but WTA coordinate matches the USFS Burgundy Col point within 200 m. Blocked: SummitPost, Mountaineers (403). MP page opened was Burgundy Spire north face, not Chianti.

No page found for a Colchuck Peak 'South Face' line. Opened Mountain Project 'West Route' (107144495): that is Dragontail Peak, reached from Colchuck Col, no trailhead named. Colchuck-area pages and reports use Stuart Lake Trailhead (USFS 47.527806,-120.820515; WTA 47.5277,-120.821) to Colchuck Lake, but no page ties this face to a start; Snow Lakes TH side is the only other conceivable one. Stuart Lake is an inference only, not evidence. SummitPost (403) blocked.

notes: Starts in use: (1) Stuart Lake TH (USFS 47.527806,-120.820515; WTA 47.5277,-120.821): thewildoutsiders Enchantment Slam report opened, climbed Enchantment Peak via Prusik Pass starting at Stuart Lake TH (winter, gate); a 2020 WTA report mention only in search. (2) Snow Lakes TH (USFS 47.544106,-120.709515; WTA snow-lakes 14 mi RT): a May 2025 Mountaineers trip report (search snippet only, not opened) camped Upper Snow Lakes including Enchantment Peak. The Mountaineers route page (blocked 403; seen only in search summary) says Prusik Pass is reached from either Colchuck Lake or Snow Lake and names neither as usual.
